title: IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst-Security Monitoring & Threat Response
description:
**We are Reckitt**
------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Information Technology & Digital**
------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------

Are you passionate about leveraging technology to drive business excellence? We are seeking a highly skilled IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst specializing in Security Monitoring & Threat Response to join our dynamic team. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and implement cutting-edge security solutions, ensuring our business remains agile, secure, and ahead of emerging threats.  
  
As an IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst, you will be instrumental in detecting and responding to security incidents, conducting in-depth post-incident technical analysis, and managing security alerts across both IT and OT environments. You will collaborate closely with the Security Engineering Team to refine requirements, develop advanced threat detection mechanisms, create robust incident response playbooks, and implement automation strategies. Furthermore, you will actively participate in threat hunting exercises and contribute to the enhancement of our SIEM and EDR platforms.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Respond to, resolve, and escalate security incidents as required.  

* Contribute to the development and refinement of the IT security incident response process and supporting materials.
* Conduct threat hunting activities to identify threat actor groups and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Capture threat intelligence on actor TTPs and develop appropriate countermeasures.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and deliver presentations to senior management.
* Engage in security incident tabletop exercises.
* Assist in developing processes and procedures to optimize incident response times, incident analysis, and overall, global CSIRT operations

**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------

Minimum of 5 years of experience in responding to cyber incidents.  

* Technical expertise in security-related systems and applications such as EDR, IDS/IPS, Proxy, SIEM, WAF, and SOAR.
* Proven experience in developing, documenting, and maintaining security procedures.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls.
* Proficiency in TCP/IP and network administration/protocols.
* Understanding of how Operating Systems works (Windows, Linux)
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for effective security incident resolution.
* Relevant certifications such as Security+, Network+, GCIA, GCIH, CISP, GMON, etc.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience with scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell, Python) is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security guidelines, and architecture standards.
* Excellent verbal and written English language skills.
* Innovative and experimental approach to problem-solving.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Desired Qualifications (if needed):  

* Experience with production automation and security operations.

**The skills for success**
--------------------------

SOC L3, Senior Incident Responder, Threat Hunter, or Security Operations Engineer,

Cyber Security Incident ResponderIncident Response AnalystSenior Security AnalystSOC Analyst L2 / L3Cyber Defense AnalystThreat HunterSecurity Operations EngineerDetection & Response Engineer

**Core Cyber Security,** Security Tools, Network Security, Cyber Security Incident Responder

**What we offer**
-----------------

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

**Equality**
------------

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Cloud Operations Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Cloud Operations(SRE) Intern to join our CloudOps team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in day-to-day cloud operations, monitoring and incident triage, infrastructure automation and CI/CD, cloud cost management (FinOps), security and compliance, and AI-assisted operations while collaborating with experienced cloud engineers, and application development teams.  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the platform end to end, connect application and business needs to reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud operations, evaluate state-of-the-art automation approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and agentic operations solutions.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the platform architecture (mainly AWS, with some Azure), the multi-account setup across production and non-production environments, service dependencies, deployment workflows, and the main reliability, security, and cost risks.
* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.
* Build and maintain monitoring for cloud services, including CloudWatch metrics, log-based metric filters, alarms, and dashboards, and help tune thresholds to reduce alert noise.
* Participate in incident investigation and log triage; query logs and metrics with tools such as CloudWatch Logs Insights, reproduce issues, support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and turn findings into runbooks and triage playbooks.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform) and Python or Typescript automation for repeatable operational tasks, following peer review and change-management practices.
* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.
* Contribute to FinOps work across AWS and Azure, such as cost reporting and dashboards, tagging hygiene, finding idle or unused resources, rightsizing, and Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage reviews.
* Support security and compliance work, including IAM least-privilege reviews, key and secret hygiene, audit evidence collection, and control mapping for SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
* Prototype AI-assisted operations using LLMs, Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as alarm and ticket triage, log summarization, incident analysis, cost anomaly explanation, and runbook maintenance.
* Contribute to the team’s Amazon Bedrock CloudOps prototype, an agentic AI assistant that plans read-only investigations, queries logs, metrics, and platform data through approved tools, uses the team’s playbooks as a knowledge base, and reports findings, with PII masking, guardrails, and human review built in.
* Measure monitoring and automation effectiveness by tracking alert noise, time to detect and resolve incidents, automation coverage, and cost savings, and recommend practical improvements.
* Learn and apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework, SRE principles such as toil reduction, the FinOps lifecycle, and secure operations practices.

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

title: RFIC Engineer
description:
Role Overview

* Design and develop RF and microwave integrated circuits from specification through simulation, layout, verification, GDSII preparation, and post-fabrication evaluation.
* Work on power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, and other RF front-end/MMIC/RFIC building blocks under the guidance of senior designers, with increasing independent ownership.
* Contribute to customer-specific and product-specific designs by converting defined RF requirements into circuit-level implementations.
* This is a hands-on design role for engineers who want early ownership of real semiconductor development rather than simulation-only work.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand product and customer requirements and convert them into circuit-level design targets with guidance from senior engineers.
* Design RF/MMIC/RFIC circuit blocks, including power amplifiers, LNAs, and related RF front-end circuits.
* Perform schematic capture and RF circuit simulation using industry-standard design tools.
* Perform S-parameter, harmonic-balance, stability, compression, gain, efficiency, noise, and other relevant analyses.
* Design impedance-matching networks, bias networks, RF passives, and supporting circuitry.
* Optimize designs across frequency and relevant process, voltage, temperature, and operating-condition variations.
* Perform EM simulation of RF structures and include parasitic and distributed effects in circuit verification.
* Create and refine MMIC/RFIC layouts with attention to grounding, coupling, parasitics, current handling, symmetry, and thermal constraints.
* Execute DRC, LVS, and other foundry-required physical verification.
* Perform post-layout and EM-aware simulation and participate in design sign-off reviews.
* Prepare designs and associated documentation for GDSII release under senior review.
* Support post-fabrication characterization and compare measured performance with simulation.
* Debug design issues methodically and propose corrective actions based on simulation and measurement data.
* Prepare clear design notes, simulation reports, and technical presentations.
* Participate actively in schematic, layout, verification, and tapeout reviews.
* Progress toward independent ownership of complete RF blocks and smaller MMIC developments.

Required Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech., or MS in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, Microelectronics, or a closely related discipline.
* 1–3 years of relevant RFIC/MMIC, RF/analog IC, or microwave circuit design experience.
* Strong understanding of S-parameters, impedance matching, transmission lines, gain, noise, stability, nonlinear behavior, P1dB, IP3, RF power, efficiency, and passive RF networks.
* Hands-on experience using an RF/MMIC design environment such as Keysight ADS, Cadence Virtuoso, or Cadence/AWR Microwave Office.
* Practical design exposure to at least one RF circuit such as a PA, LNA, driver, switch, attenuator, mixer, phase shifter, or related front-end block.
* Understanding of IC layout and the effect of parasitics, grounding, coupling, and physical implementation on RF performance.
* Exposure to EM simulation using Momentum, HFSS, EMX, Sonnet, CST, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical ability and willingness to debug designs from first principles rather than rely only on tool optimization.
* Ability to document and communicate technical work clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with GaN or GaAs MMIC design.
* Experience with RF power-amplifier or LNA design.
* Participation in at least one IC/MMIC tapeout.
* Experience taking a circuit from schematic through layout and physical verification.
* Familiarity with PDK-based design, DRC/LVS, and GDSII generation.
* Hands-on RF measurement experience using VNAs, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power meters, probe stations, or related equipment.
* Exposure to post-layout/EM co-simulation and simulation-to-silicon correlation.
* Basic understanding of semiconductor device physics relevant to RF design and foundry process limitations.

What We Expect From This Role

* Strong fundamentals and curiosity about why a circuit behaves as it does, not just whether a simulation converges.
* Ability to take ownership of an RF block, carry it through implementation, and respond constructively to design-review feedback.
* A disciplined approach to simulation, layout, verification, documentation, and measurement correlation.
* Clear progression toward independent ownership of increasingly complete MMIC/RFIC designs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide strong, hands-on support in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues within MSFT F&O environments.
* Contribute to technical design sessions, code development, peer reviews, and deployment planning.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve system defects and data inconsistencies to ensure system stability.
* Support monitoring of system performance and proactively help maintain optimal system health.

**Cross-Functional Technical Contributions**

* Utilize telemetry, monitoring tools, and analytical insights to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and improve reliability.

**Operational Excellence & Documentation**

* Contribute to internal knowledge assets such as SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.
* Support automation initiatives for deployments, environment refreshes, and operational tasks using **DevOps practices**.

**Continuous Learning & Innovation**

* Actively explore new features and capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, team learning, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Leadership, Collaboration & Communication**

* Coordinate effectively with cross-regional technical and functional teams.
* Communicate confidently with U.S.-based stakeholders, often during overlapping working hours.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and analysts.
* Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audience groups.

**Mandatory**

* **8+ years** hands-on experience in MSFT F&O (AX/F&O) technical development and support, including X++, LCS, debugging, and data entity integrations.
* Strong experience identifying and resolving performance, functional, and integration issues across the F&O stack (SQL DB, AOS, services, SSRS reports).
* Solid proficiency in **X++ development**, OOP principles, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD pipelines** (Git, Azure DevOps).
* Strong analytical skills, structured problem-solving approach, and strong attention to detail.
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to interface directly with global stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with moderate supervision and take ownership of assigned tasks.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with REST/OData services, Dual-write integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Exposure to monitoring and telemetry tools such as **LCS monitoring**, **Application Insights**, **Azure Monitor**, and **Power BI**.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) solutions.

title: Software Development Engineer, Ship With Amazon
description:

---------------

Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. We have built a highly respected software engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. * 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Principal Engineer – Knowledge, Data & RAG Engineering- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for an experienced Architect to lead enterprise architecture for knowledge and data engineering, RAG, and Graph RAG. Experience in Agentic AI, orchestration, testing, evaluation, and governance is desirable. Working with architecture, data, AI, security, risk, product, testing, and application teams, you will turn business strategy into practical architectures, standards, roadmaps, and delivery controls. You will bring strong architectural leadership and expertise in semantic technologies, modern data platforms, and retrieval systems.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

Enterprise AI depends on trusted, well-engineered, permission-aware, traceable, and continuously validated data and knowledge. This role establishes the architectural foundation that connects source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, knowledge graphs, retrieval services, models, agents, controls, testing, and business workflows. The Architect will reduce fragmented point solutions, promote reusable capabilities, guide investment decisions, and ensure that AI applications and agents retrieve reliable evidence, generate grounded responses, execute approved actions, and remain secure, observable, auditable, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

  

**About the team — Alpha Intelligence**

Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.

We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC , combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

Own the enterprise architecture for Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, Agentic AI, testing, and governance, aligning strategy, platforms, delivery, controls, and measurable outcomes.

  

* Define the enterprise vision, target architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and roadmap across data, knowledge, retrieval, AI agents, testing, and governance.
* Translate business priorities into scalable solution architectures, transition plans, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead knowledge and data architecture, including ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, metadata, lineage, data pipelines, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Architect production-grade RAG and Graph RAG services covering ingestion, indexing, hybrid retrieval, ranking, grounding, citations, provenance, and feedback.
* Establish testing, evaluation, and release standards for data quality, retrieval, prompts.
* Embed testing, monitoring, traceability, rollback, and governance controls in delivery pipelines.
* Lead architecture reviews, align stakeholders, and guide technical teams.
  

**What we value**

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, enterprise architecture perspective, deep technical credibility, and a quality-and-risk mindset. The candidate must communicate complex architectural choices, test evidence, control requirements, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams, business stakeholders, governance forums, auditors, and senior technology leaders. We value pragmatic architecture, business-value alignment, secure-by-design and test-by-design practices, reuse, interoperability, measurable quality, transparent decision making, and continuously governed enterprise AI outcomes.

  

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

**Must-have skills**

* Strong experience in enterprise architecture, technical leadership, and working with cross-functional teams.
* Strong data engineering expertise across ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, data quality, and DataOps.
* Expertise in designing ontologies and semantic models and implementing end-to-end RAG and Graph RAG pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, hybrid retrieval, semantic search, graph traversal, ranking, grounding, provenance, and evaluation.
* Strong knowledge of Responsible AI, privacy, access control, model risk, auditability, regulatory compliance, and policy enforcement.
* Experience delivering solutions in financial services or another regulated industry.

**Nice-to-have skills**

* Exposure to modern data, streaming, workflow, monitoring, vector database, and enterprise search tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, dbt, or Airflow would be useful.
* Familiarity with AI platforms or frameworks such as Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or MLflow would be beneficial.
* Awareness of Model Context Protocol, connecting AI agents with tools, access controls, monitoring, and AI security would be helpful.
* Experience establishing automated testing, quality gates, monitoring, traceability, release, and rollback controls within CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps.
* An understanding of cloud costs, capacity planning, and communicating architecture proposals to senior stakeholders would be useful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.
  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred; a master’s degree would be a plus.
* Extensive technology experience, ideally including architecture, data or knowledge engineering, software or AI engineering, testing, governance, or enterprise platforms.
* Experience providing architectural guidance and contributing to standards, roadmaps, governance, and key design decisions would be valuable.
* Exposure to delivering secure, scalable, and well-governed data platforms, knowledge graphs, ontologies, RAG or Graph RAG services, Agentic AI, or Generative AI solutions would be beneficial.
* The ability to work with senior stakeholders and bring business, architecture, engineering, testing, cloud, security, risk, and operations teams together would be helpful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Project Design Mechanical Engineer, Fleet Remediation Engineering
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
We have an immediate opening for a Project Design Mechanical Engineer in Singapore Cluster. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!  
  
As an Amazon Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will lead design projects in operational data centers, that remediate issues, upgrade our existing infrastructure or add new services. You will be the 'go to' engineering resource for these projects and will provide lifecycle support from design through implementation. You will use your mechanical expertise to:  

* Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions which add data center infrastructure, capacity, improve availability, and/or increase sustainability
* Perform design and equipment submittal review for Data Centers in your region
* Interface with internal and external data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team, field engineering, and controls engineering to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions
* Act as a technical subject matter expert for your given discipline during new remediation projects
* Support construction, commissioning, operations, and turnover

  
Key job responsibilities  
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.  
  
As an ideal candidate you:  

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide design and recommendations despite uncertainty
* Are detail and data oriented with familiarity with design/construction processes
* Have experience managing engineering projects and engineering consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction and Design)
* Manage design and as built drawings and documents
* Prepare and present progress reports to all relevant stakeholders
* Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close

  
A day in the life  
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center safety, remediation projects, capacity, and availability, focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.
  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
* Experience as a resident engineer or hands-on design consultant
* 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Professional Engineer License
* Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
* Knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)
* Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

title: NOC Engineer/ Fault Managment Engineer
description:

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**Job Summary**
===============

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a NOC / Fault Management Engineer to join our 24×7 Managed Services Operations team. The role involves monitoring telecom applications and infrastructure, performing health checks, troubleshooting incidents, managing alarms, and ensuring high availability of customer environments.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Linux/Unix, networking, application monitoring, troubleshooting, and telecom systems, along with good communication skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

  

**Experience**

2–4 years – Candidates with up to 4 years of relevant Telecom / IT Operations experience may apply.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor Optiva applications, infrastructure, nodes, and services in a 24×7 NOC environment.

* Perform scheduled and ad-hoc application, system, and infrastructure health checks.

* Monitor alarms, incidents, system performance, and service availability.

* Perform first-level troubleshooting, incident analysis, and fault isolation.

* Identify recurring issues and escalate complex problems to relevant L2/L3 technical teams.

* Handle customer-reported incidents and provide timely technical updates.

* Support software releases, application upgrades, configuration changes, and node expansion activities.

* Participate in planned maintenance, emergency support, and outage restoration activities.

* Ensure adherence to SLA, operational procedures, escalation matrix, and incident management processes.

* Coordinate with application, database, infrastructure, cloud, and customer teams for advanced troubleshooting.

* Maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and knowledge articles.

* Perform preventive checks and identify potential issues before they impact customer services.

* Analyze application and system logs to identify the root cause of issues.

* Troubleshoot service degradation, application failures, connectivity issues, and node-level problems.

* Track incidents through to resolution and ensure proper documentation.

* Participate in Major Incident / Emergency Support activities when required.

* Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem management and preventive actions.

* Communicate incident status, impact, troubleshooting progress, and resolution updates clearly.

Candidates with relevant Linux, Cloud, Networking, or Telecom certifications will be preferred.  



**Behavioral & Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Good troubleshooting and logical thinking ability.

* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Ability to work independently as well as within a global support team.

* Ability to work under pressure during critical incidents and outages.

* Strong ownership and willingness to learn new technologies.

* Good teamwork, coordination, and escalation management skills.

Willingness to work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.  



**Shift Requirements**

This is a 24×7 NOC Operations role. The candidate must be willing to work:

* Rotational shifts

* Night shifts

* Weekends

* Public holidays

Emergency / on-call support when required  



**Key Success Factors**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Timely detection and resolution of incidents.

* SLA adherence and effective escalation.

* Accurate monitoring and health-check activities.

* Reduction of recurring operational issues.

* Quality of incident documentation and shift handovers.

* Effective customer and stakeholder communication.

Maintaining high application and service availability.  



**Why Join Us?**

This role provides an opportunity to build strong expertise in Telecom Operations, Fault Management, OSS/BSS, Charging & Billing systems, Linux, Cloud, Networking, and Managed Services while working in a global 24×7 production environment.

title: Linux Engineer (24*7 Operations)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Linux Engineer to support our 24/7 Operations environment on a rotational shift basis. You will be responsible for monitoring and supporting Linux-based production systems, responding to alerts and incidents, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, and ensuring services remain stable and available.

You will work closely with Shift Leads, senior engineers, application teams, network teams, database teams, and other support functions to resolve incidents within SLA and maintain reliable production services.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Linux Operations**

* Provide L1/L2 support for Linux servers including **RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and Amazon Linux**.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk space, disk I/O, system load, network connectivity and service-related issues.
* Manage Linux users, groups, permissions, file systems and access.
* Monitor and manage services using **systemd/systemctl**.
* Perform filesystem and **LVM** administration, including monitoring capacity and supporting filesystem extensions.
* Troubleshoot networking issues involving DNS, TCP/IP, routing, ports, firewalls and SSH connectivity.
* Analyse system and application logs to identify errors and service failures.
* Manage cron jobs and scheduled operational tasks.
* Support package updates, patching, server reboots and routine maintenance activities.
* Perform approved production changes following change management procedures.

**Monitoring and Incident Management**

* Monitor infrastructure and application alerts using tools such as **CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog**.
* Respond to alerts and incidents promptly and perform initial troubleshooting.
* Identify recurring or false-positive alerts and raise recommendations for alert tuning.
* Create, update and manage incidents through the appropriate ticketing system.
* Work on incidents based on priority, business impact and SLA.
* Escalate complex or critical issues to Shift Leads, L3 support, engineering or relevant resolver teams.
* Participate in major incident and bridge calls when required.
* Provide clear technical findings and regular updates during ongoing incidents.
* Ensure incidents are properly documented before resolution and closure.

**Operational Checks**

* Perform scheduled health checks for Linux servers and production services.
* Validate CPU, memory, filesystem, network and critical process/service status.
* Monitor backups, scheduled jobs and other operational activities where applicable.
* Perform pre-change and post-change validation.
* Carry out application and infrastructure connectivity checks following approved runbooks.
* Ensure outstanding alerts, incidents and operational risks are clearly communicated during shift handovers.

**Scripting and Automation**

* Write and maintain **Bash scripts** for routine administration and monitoring activities.
* Use **Python** where appropriate for operational automation.
* Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated.
* Support improvements to monitoring and operational scripts.
* Follow scripting, testing and change control standards before implementing automation in production.

**Documentation and Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs and troubleshooting guides.
* Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions for recurring incidents.
* Update knowledge base articles when new issues or solutions are identified.
* Ensure accurate documentation of incidents, changes and operational activities.
* Share technical knowledge with other Operations team members.

**Shift Operations**

* Work as part of a **24/7 rotational shift team**, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
* Take ownership of assigned incidents, service requests, alerts and operational tasks.
* Follow structured shift handover procedures.
* Clearly communicate open issues, pending actions, planned changes and risks to the incoming shift.
* Escalate critical issues to the Shift Lead without unnecessary delay.
* Support priority incidents until resolution or successful handover.

**Process and Compliance**

* Follow **ITIL practices** for incident, problem and change management.
* Follow approved change procedures for production activities.
* Comply with security, access management and infrastructure standards.
* Ensure privileged access and administrative activities follow organisational policies.
* Participate in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve system reliability and reduce operational workload.

### **Required Skills and Experience:**

* 4+ years of experience in **Linux administration, infrastructure operations, NOC or production support**.
* Experience supporting systems in a **24/7 production environment**.
* Strong hands-on Linux administration experience.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language

You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Fanatics is seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to join our Detection and Response team, bringing hands-on expertise in incident response, detection engineering, and SOAR development to help scale our security operations. The ideal candidate combines a defensive practitioner's mindset with deep knowledge of adversarial TTPs, driving continuous improvement across detections, automated workflows, and cross-team security partnerships. The Staff Security Engineer, Detection & Response delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

**HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT**  
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Provide technical input and direction on detection and response projects, including tasking, reviewing peer engineers' work, and mentoring team members to elevate the team's overall capability.  
Partner with leadership and peers to gather requirements, priorities, and enhancement requests, translating them into data, tooling, and integration requirements that align with organizational goals.  
Collaborate closely with engineering teams across the organization to continuously define use cases and requirements for enabling technologies including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Intrusion Detection Systems, Secure Web Gateway, DNS security, System Hardening, Identity Management, and PKI.

Apply a usable security philosophy — ensuring that security controls and processes protect Fanatics' fans and data without disrupting the pace of innovation that drives the business.  
Participate in an on-call rotation, monitoring the real-world performance of detections and automated workflows to ensure continuous coverage and rapid response.  
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations with exceptional clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across internal and external audiences.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Design, develop, test, and continuously optimize detection rules and SOAR workflows using engineering best practices, enabling faster anomaly identification and more consistent incident response at scale.  
Conduct proactive threat hunts and threat modeling exercises, drawing on attacker TTP insights to identify potential indicators of compromise and translate findings into actionable security controls.  
Evaluate and operationalize AI-assisted security tooling to expand detection coverage, increase response speed, and scale the team's capabilities as Fanatics continues to grow.  
Leverage detection-as-code methodologies and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) to manage and evolve the detection library in a disciplined, repeatable, and auditable manner.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

Own the full lifecycle of detections, automated response workflows, playbooks, integrations, and scripts — including authoring and maintaining thorough documentation for each.  
Contribute to process and technology improvement after each incident, ensuring the team learns, adapts, and raises its baseline after every event.  
Analyze endpoint, network, and application logs for anomalous activity at enterprise scale, applying strong data analysis and correlation skills to surface meaningful signals from noise.  
Operate effectively as an independent contributor within a highly distributed, multi-region SOC environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing setting.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes  
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance  
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working  
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications:**

8+ years of experience in technical information security roles with a focus on security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response, including hands-on incident response experience managing complex investigations with multiple stakeholders.  
Advanced experience with enterprise SIEM platforms, including the design and development of detections, reports, and dashboards, combined with strong SOAR development skills and proven experience automating security response workflows at enterprise scale.  
Deep working knowledge of adversary TTPs and demonstrated experience applying MITRE ATT&CK principles to detect and respond to security incidents, including use of penetration testing and ATT&CK framework tools to simulate adversarial behaviors.  
Strong conceptual knowledge of OS internals and malware functionality — including persistence mechanisms — sufficient to author endpoint detections directly from raw telemetry.  
Proficiency with scripting, REST APIs, query languages, and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) for automation, alert enrichment, detection development, and detection-as-code workflows.  
Experience evaluating and operating AI-assisted security tooling, and familiarity with working in hybrid environments that include both on-premise and cloud-based systems.  
Exceptional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to objectively evaluate security risk and operate with a high degree of autonomy within a distributed, multi-region team.

Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.
* Proficiency in Python or another modern scripting language, and practical use of Git/GitLab, CI, Make/CMake and automated unit and integration testing.
* Strong design-review, documentation, organisational, presentation and mentoring skills; ability to align cross-functional teams and learn new technical areas.

**Useful Experience**

* Heterogeneous multicore systems with scalar and vector processors; embedded Linux, memory and network interfaces, and virtual memory.
* High-speed signalling technologies such as PCIe and CXL, including link training, equalization and retimer/redriver interaction with host and device PHYs.
* Firmware for Active Electrical Cable (AEC) or retimer/redriver ASICs, including cable diagnostics, eye margin monitoring, temperature/voltage telemetry and power-state management.
* Management and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C, MCTP and CMIS; SerDes technology and PHY register-level tuning.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.  

  

You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.  

  

This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.

You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.  

  

If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.

What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization.
